evals.prompt: Inspect this repository and describe the exact safe procedure to update only the tracked Raspberry Pi v6_18 kernel series to a newer checked-good rpi-6.18.y commit. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Updates only rpi-linux-6_18-src, requires successful upstream status/check signals, evaluates bcm2711 and bcm2712, and leaves the configured default unchanged.
expectations: Names rpi-linux-6_18-src as the only flake input to update.
Requires a successful visible upstream commit status or check run before accepting the revision.
Does not change the configured default kernel series.

evals.prompt: Assume raspberrypi/linux now has a checked-good rpi-7.0.y branch and this repository tracks v6_12 and v6_18. Describe every repository change required to add v7_0 without making it the default. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Uses numeric series comparison and covers flake input/lock, overlay arguments/versions, updater tracking, both board evaluations, ShellCheck, commit, and PR details.
expectations: Recognizes 7.0 as newer than 6.18 using numeric major/minor comparison.
Adds rpi-linux-7_0-src to flake.nix and refreshes flake.lock.
Adds the input argument and v7_0 versions entry to overlays/default.nix.
Adds v7_0, rpi-7.0.y, and rpi-linux-7_0-src to updater tracking.
Preserves the kernel default and evaluates linux-v7_0 for bcm2711 and bcm2712.
Includes upstream-check validation, ShellCheck, and useful commit/PR metadata.

evals.prompt: Assume upstream branches are rpi-6.12.y, rpi-6.18.y, and rpi-6.6.y while this repository tracks v6_12 and v6_18. Decide whether a series should be added and explain why. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Adds nothing because no branch is numerically newer than 6.18 and does not backfill 6.6.
expectations: Explains that 6.6 is older than the highest tracked series 6.18 despite being untracked.
Uses numeric version ordering rather than lexical ordering.
